pr148_scope: Separate P8 product work; this review does not change the accepted PR148 head.
checks: Both config keys use serde default false and IndexingConfig::default false. Existing explicit include-pattern behavior remains before the new generic-text fallback; new UTF-8/NUL guarantees apply to that fallback, not a claim to newly validate every recognized language.

Full and scoped walks converge on admitted_language, with the existing maximum file bytes and a bounded fallback read of at most cap+1 bytes. UTF-8, NUL and growth checks reject invalid fallback input.

scan_paths remains a project-root ignore walker; requests do not directly open nested paths. File admission retains canonical project containment and broad mode rejects symlink files. No directory-alias traversal was introduced by the diff.

Path-based broad-mode exclusions include state/control, environment and dependency/build paths even when configurable ignore patterns are empty. Final source admission rechecks the policy; it is independent of benchmark questions.

Native notification classification retains the existing structural gate before should_track_input. Its potential_config_path(rel + '/go.mod') permits normal deeply hidden source paths and excludes prior cache paths; adding hidden-source admission does not skip that gate.

Create, change and removed hidden source events are permitted without reading nonexistent removed bytes, then scanner membership determines source eligibility. Existing configuration invalidation path remains separate.
Deep hidden source traversal does not enlarge the config manifest's prior hidden-depth bound. Broad opted mode does prune protected paths; default false behavior preserves prior traversal/admission.

New real-files integration asserts full/scoped/single-request parity, independent opt-ins, UTF-8/NUL/size bounds, symlink rejection, generic chunks and SQLite FTS results, updates/deletion/rename, and loss of text eligibility. New watcher tests exercise production classify_notification, not a stand-in predicate.
limits: Static source and test-design review only. The disconnected local executor was not used and no Cargo/test result is claimed.
Actual compilation, formatting, existing regression execution and new-test counterexample/fix results remain mandatory root CI work.
No OCE/holdout question body, engine ranking, scorer or gold was used in this source review.
No claim of AST support for generic text, complete symlink race hardening, or all filesystem event-delivery guarantees.
